<MethodEndpoint

Returns a signing link for an existing signature request. This enables presenting signing links within your own applications (mobile apps, web portals, etc.) instead of relying solely on email-based signing flows.

  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>

>
  
</ParamsDetails>

  body={{"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","required":["signer_email"],"properties":{"signer_email":{"type":"string","format":"email","description":"Email address of the signer whose signing link should be generated."}}},"example":{"signer_email":"tenant@example.com"}}}}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>
